statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I49.5, I48.91, R55
Mobile cardiac telemetry CPT 93229 was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
